items.title: Welcome to the AGI era of AI governance
items.summary: The executive branch of the United States forcing Anthropic to turn off access — both internally and externally — to their latest Claude 5 Mythos/Fable models is the starting gun of a new era in AI governance. This is the era defining AI agents that effectively complement human workers, unlocking new ways of working and new domains of applying existing tools. items.title: Introducing the OpenAI Partner Network
items.summary: OpenAI launches the Partner Network, investing $150M to help global partners accelerate enterprise AI adoption, deployment, and transformation.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI正式推出“OpenAI合作伙伴网络”（OpenAI Partner Network），并投入1.5亿美元资金，旨在帮助全球合作伙伴加速企业级AI的采用、部署与业务转型。该计划加强了OpenAI在企业级市场的生态布局，为企业用户提供更贴合的落地支持。
